coupon_short_description: Get All Dinosaurs in Jurassic Genesis Roblox
coupon_description: <p>Welcome to Jurassic Genesis! This is a game where you can roleplay as many dinosaurs from the Jurassic franchises. Meet new friends, slay dinosaurs, and have fun exploring the expansive map ingame! From Microceratus to Spinosaurus, the choice is yours to play as! Or, play as an InGen hunter and try to fight the dinosaurs as a human.</p>
